## 2026-11-03

### Impact

- **Fixed unresponsive bottom buttons in some embedded pages.** On iOS 26 and 27, buttons near the bottom of some third-party pages, such as Plaid, could highlight when tapped without activating until the user scrolled. Taps now register right away.
- **Fixed native login hangs when a page navigates mid-step.** If a page navigated while the SDK was running a script on it, that step could wait forever. It now finishes and continues on the new page.

### Changes

- Added `TransactSession`, a session-based API for presenting Transact with shared configuration and callbacks (#374)
- Added launch API attribution (`present` vs. `session`) and session-level observability to SDK telemetry, and improved the accuracy of the reported Xcode version (#376)
- Fixed tappable regions inside the Transact web view being offset by the top bar height (#375)
- Fixed in-progress page scripts never returning when a navigation replaced the page (#380)

### Products

- Deposit
- Switch
- Manage

### Requirements

| Name  | Version |
| ----- | ------- |
| Xcode | >= 26.1 |
| iOS   | >= 15.0 |
